blocks.text: Department of International Cooperation and Investments
Отдел международных связей

The Department of International Cooperation and Investments (DICI) is a structural subdivision of Bishkek State University named after Academician K. Karasaev (hereinafter referred to as the University). The Department operates under the direct supervision of the Rector and the Vice-Rector for International Relations and Investments.

The Department was established to coordinate and strengthen the University's international cooperation, with the aim of enhancing its international standing in education, research, and public engagement.
Functions of the Department
carrying out work to establish and develop connections between BSU and foreign educational and scientific institutions and organizations;

obtaining information about foreign grants, their terms and conditions; – timely communication to the management of the university departments and assistance to BSU departments in obtaining foreign grants;
organization of international cooperation between BSU and educational institutions and public organizations of foreign countries;
development of double degree and internship programs for students and postgraduates, ensuring their availability: exchanges, loans, grants;
planning protocol events for international research cooperation at BSU;

organizing the reception of foreign representatives: planning the dates and programs for the reception of foreign specialists, delegations, postgraduate students, interns, and students (for all types of training) at BSU;

preparation of agreements between BSU on its cooperation with foreign educational and scientific institutions and organizations in the field of implementation of educational and scientific research programs;
enhancing the presence of BSU in the international educational community and in major international educational and scientific programs;

Providing visa support and related administrative assistance to international students, academic staff, researchers, and other foreign nationals arriving in the Kyrgyz Republic to study or work at Bishkek State University.
